assertions.assertion: Recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness concerning for paroxysmal arrhythmia
CPT 93247 is a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study
Symptoms are intermittent and must be correlated with cardiac rhythm disturbances
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated to capture potential arrhythmic events
CPT 93247 claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197 for missing precertification
